concerns.text: Constitution Principle VI requires exactly 1000 ΛCDM Gaussian realizations, but the plan states it will generate ≥ 10 000 realizations (see ‘Constitution Check’ and Phase 5). This directly violates the per‑project constitution.
The plan references a non‑existent functional requirement ID ‘FR‑400e2b33’ (Phase 3 – Cold‑Spot Detection). No such FR is defined in the specification, causing a traceability mismatch.
